description_en: Assigns a role to a member of a DataWorks workspace. Before you call this operation, you must add your account to a DataWorks workspace as a member
description_zh: 该接口用于添加DataWorks工作空间用户至角色。使用该接口前，您需要先添加目标账号为DataWorks工作空间的成员
name: AddProjectMemberToRole

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780068.html operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780068.html接口获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner to view the ID
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云账号ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，鼠标悬停至顶部菜单栏右侧的用户头像，查看账号ID
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The code of the role that you want to assign to a member of the DataWorks workspace. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780079.html operation to query the codes of all roles in a DataWorks workspace
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间角色的Code。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2780079.html获取角色的Code
parameters.name: role_code

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. We recommend that you set this parameter to a UUID. This parameter is used to uniquely identify the API operation call
parameters.help_zh: 幂等字段，建议使用UUID。用于唯一标识此次调用操作
parameters.name: client_token
